name: visual-director
description: Turn visual requests into precise prompts, traceable image-generation handoffs, and approval-gated assets.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, generate, review, and safely land image assets.
interface.longDescription: Visual Director structures visual briefs, selects explainable prompt templates, records provider-neutral generation attempts, and prevents failed or unapproved candidates from becoming formal assets.
defaultPrompt: Create a precise visual brief and generation plan for this image request.
Review this candidate against its visual brief and report every failed gate.
Prepare one approval-gated image-generation handoff without overwriting assets.
